evidence.quote: La sottomissione della domanda di richiesta di visto sul portale ministeriale esterno a Unige (Universitaly) è obbligatoria per tutti i corsi.

notes: Computer Engineering at UniGe is a Bachelor programme taught in Italian, but no page dedicated to this programme's own site (corsi.unige.it) was supplied, so no programme page or programme-specific facts (duration, teaching language, tuition) could be quoted. Tuition is left out: the only fee page found states general ISEE-band contributions up to EUR 3,300 for 'oltre € 100.000 ovvero in assenza di ISEE-U', but no single amount is stated for a non-EU full-time Bachelor student living abroad. Documents for this Bachelor are not quoted from an international-student page; the document list found applies to Master's degrees. The B2 English requirement is quoted from the page on enrolling non-EU students resident abroad with a foreign qualification, and applies to Italian-taught courses only if an English-taught track is chosen.

note.fr: Vérifie les dates d'ouverture et de clôture de la pré-sélection UnigeApply (fall session), de la demande de visa sur Universitaly et de la pré-inscription, selon ton profil et l'année académique.
note.en: Check the opening and closing dates of the UnigeApply pre-selection (fall session), the visa application on Universitaly and the pre-enrolment, according to your profile and academic year.
